source.page_title: Global Travel and Expense Policy | The GitLab Handbook
source.scope_note: Only the listed lines were copied. This is not a complete copy of the page or any section. original_text preserves the wording observed at the cited line range; heading_path is stored separately.

sections.extraction_scope: Two bullets: existing-team-member refresh; additional equipment.
sections.original_text:
Existing Team Members will get a yearly refresh of 500 USD (or equivalent local currency) to purchase upgrades, replacements, or enhancements to your home office setup. This only applies to Team Members who have been employed the entire previous calendar year. This excludes laptops - please connect with the IT team if you require a replacement laptop.
Further to this, items like additional monitors, laptop stand, external webcam, supplementary lighting, laptop bag/case, can also be considered and expensed using the Stipend/Allowance.

sections.extraction_scope: Three list items only: monitors/stands, replacement laptop battery, replacement laptop charger.
sections.original_text:
Monitor(s) and monitor stands
Replacement for Laptop battery
Replacement for Laptop charger

sections.extraction_scope: The refresh and damage-replacement bullet only.
sections.original_text: Team Member laptops can be refreshed after three years of employment. If a Team Member needs a replacement laptop due to damage, they must reach out to IT via an issue before purchasing a new one. See Laptop handbook page for your reference.

sections.extraction_scope: Three bullets only: small replacements, manager approval, approved IT issue.
sections.original_text:
If you need to replace a battery, laptop charger, or something small that does not affect the productivity or speed of the device, please go ahead and get that small item replaced and expensed.
Please get approval from your Manager if your equipment appears to be damaged, defective, or in need of repair
Needs to have an approved issue from the IT team.
Up to $5,000 can be expensed via Navan.
